title: A Gray Morning
description: The hero arrives at the Spark Academy as the Hush dims the morning bells.
captions: Lumeria: a sky full of floating islands, where science and magic grew into one thing.
Everything here runs on Sparks, the little glow that learning makes.
But this morning a gray fog drifts between the islands. People call it the Hush.
Where the Hush settles, things forget. Numbers slip off signs. Maps fade. The Academy bell forgets how to ring.
And in a brand-new apprentice's satchel, an egg begins to wobble...

title: A Path and a Friend
description: The hero chooses a class and the egg hatches into a baby companion.
captions: Every apprentice chooses a path. You chose yours: {class}.
Crack. Crackle. POP! The egg hatches, and out tumbles {companion}.
{companion} looks at you. You look at {companion}. That settles it: friends.
Professor Quill is waiting in the plaza.

title: Counting Cloister
description: The hero steps into the Counting Cloister.
captions: The numbers have slipped off the walls and lie in little heaps on the floor.
Somewhere inside, something is muddled. Time to help.

title: Abacuss the Muddled
description: Abacuss the Muddled appears, muddled by the Hush.
captions: A round, rattling golem spins in circles, muttering "one, two, seven, banana".
It is not mean. It is muddled. Dodge until it gets dizzy, then help it remember!

title: Abacuss the Muddled Remembers
description: Abacuss the Muddled remembers, and the temple wakes.
captions: Abacuss blinks. "...three! It was THREE!" It counts every bead, twice, beaming.
The fog in the temple thins. A chest glimmers nearby.

title: Glow Lantern
description: The hero earns the Glow Lantern.
captions: You hold up the Glow Lantern. {companion} does a little spin.
It melts Hush fog. The Lantern Library is next, north of the plaza.

title: Lantern Library
description: The hero steps into the Lantern Library.
captions: Shelves stretch into the fog. Every book is dark, and very quiet.
Somewhere inside, something is muddled. Time to help.

title: Dimwick
description: Dimwick appears, muddled by the Hush.
captions: A big fuzzy moth flutters into shelves, bumping and apologising to the books.
It is not mean. It is muddled. Dodge until it gets dizzy, then help it remember!

title: Dimwick Remembers
description: Dimwick remembers, and the temple wakes.
captions: Dimwick remembers: glow comes from inside. The whole Library lights up, page by page.
The fog in the temple thins. A chest glimmers nearby.

title: Hop Boots
description: The hero earns the Hop Boots.
captions: You hold up the Hop Boots. {companion} does a little spin.
Springy! The gap in the north-east will not stop you now.

title: Skip-Stone Sanctum
description: The hero steps into the Skip-Stone Sanctum.
captions: Stepping stones hang over a starry drop. Some have wandered off.
Somewhere inside, something is muddled. Time to help.

title: Boingle
description: Boingle appears, muddled by the Hush.
captions: A springy hop-bot bounces off the ceiling, the wall, and its own foot.
It is not mean. It is muddled. Dodge until it gets dizzy, then help it remember!

title: Boingle Remembers
description: Boingle remembers, and the temple wakes.
captions: Boingle lands. Exactly where it meant to. It is so surprised that it sits down.
The fog in the temple thins. A chest glimmers nearby.

title: Echo Whistle
description: The hero earns the Echo Whistle.
captions: You hold up the Echo Whistle. {companion} does a little spin.
One clear note wakes the gate at the far north-east.

title: Echo Hall
description: The hero steps into the Echo Hall.
captions: A hall built for sound, holding its breath.
Somewhere inside, something is muddled. Time to help.

title: Hushaby Bell
description: Hushaby Bell appears, muddled by the Hush.
captions: A huge bell swings on its rope, searching for its own ring.
It is not mean. It is muddled. Dodge until it gets dizzy, then help it remember!

title: Hushaby Bell Remembers
description: Hushaby Bell remembers, and the temple wakes.
captions: The answer rings out, and so does the bell: one warm note that rolls across every island.
The fog in the temple thins. A chest glimmers nearby.

title: Tide Charm
description: The hero earns the Tide Charm.
captions: You hold up the Tide Charm. {companion} does a little spin.
Water grows calm beneath it. The Tide Vault is south-west.

title: Tide Vault
description: The hero walks across the water into the Tide Vault.
captions: Under the tide, the oldest memories of Lumeria sleep in glass shells.
Someone has been here. The shelves are stuffed. More and more and more.

title: Old Driftwhirl
description: The tide turtle has forgotten which way the current goes.
captions: An ancient turtle paddles in worried circles, stirring up swirls.
It is not mean. It is muddled. Dodge until it gets dizzy, then help it remember!

title: The Reveal
description: Old Driftwhirl remembers who the Hush really is.
captions: Old Driftwhirl grows calm. "Thank you, little one. Now I remember. I remember HER."
"Long ago the First Archivist, Ellowen, promised to keep every bit of knowledge safe. Every number. Every story. Every song."
"She gathered and stored and gathered. She never stopped. Not even when she became a ghost."
"The Hush is not a monster, child. It is Ellowen: still collecting, all alone, and she has forgotten how to stop."
"She does not need fighting. She needs someone to teach her back."

title: Star Compass
description: The hero earns the Star Compass.
captions: The Star Compass spins once and points south-east, steady as a promise.
{companion} tugs your sleeve. Time to meet the Hush.

title: The Hush
description: The hero meets the Hush: the lonely ghost of Archivist Ellowen.
captions: Every story, every number, every song, shelved up to the stars.
And in the middle, a soft gray shape, sorting and sorting and sorting.
"Must keep it safe. All of it. Mine to keep. Must not lose a single page..."
Pages swirl around her like snow. She cannot hear you yet.
Dodge the drifting pages. When she pauses, teach her what she forgot!

title: Teaching It Back
description: Finale: the hero teaches the Hush back by answering questions, and Ellowen remembers.
captions: With every answer you share, a little colour comes back into the gray.
"Oh," says Ellowen. "Knowledge is not for keeping. It is for giving away. You just gave it to me, and you still have it."
She laughs, and it sounds like a hundred pages turning. "I forgot the best part. I forgot to share."
All across Lumeria the fog lifts. The numbers climb back onto their signs. The bell remembers its ring.

title: A Bright Morning
description: Ending: Ellowen becomes the Academy librarian and the hero's friend.
captions: Ellowen is the Academy librarian now. She lends every book she has, and she waves when they leave.
Professor Quill pins a ribbon on your coat. {companion} gets a smaller one.
There are still creatures to befriend, ghosts to cheer up, and questions to wonder about.
After all, every question is a little light. Thank you for playing, {nick}.
